versions.changelog:
- Added _meta.json file for improved metadata and ecosystem compatibility.
- No changes to functionality or user interface.
Clarify provider-specific outbound image delivery requirements and fix a missing base64 import in the Workers AI image script.

Changed delivery flow to require --output and use temporary local files for chat handoff. OpenClaw now sends generated images from the saved path and removes temporary files after successful delivery. Removed base64 and raw stdout image output modes.
Deliver generated images to chat by default without local persistence; only save to a local file when explicitly requested by the user.
Initial public release with Cloudflare Workers AI text-to-image and image-to-image workflows, Docker Compose environment variable support, smoke tests, and chat-oriented delivery guidance.
